Is it legal to change out cards from a hero deck? 

 

I know this is not a deck building game but after playing Legacy several times now, I can see 2 or 3 cards I would like to change out for some of the stronger cards.

For example, there are cards like "Lead From The Front" and "Heroic Interception" that aren't needed all that often and there are 3 of each in the deck.  Where as "The Legacy Ring" is needed every game and there is only 2 of those cards in the deck.  I would love to be able to ditch 1 of each of "Lead From The Front" and "Heroic Interception" to put in a couple more "The Legacy Ring" cards.

posts.name: BlueHairedMeerkat
posts.cooked:
Essentially, on your turn you draw a card, then play one. Cards can give you points, take away points or do damn near anything else. The unique bit of the game is that all the cards are player-created; everyone makes some cards before the game starts, and these are shuffled together with blank cards that can be made into new cards during the game. (There's a completed forum game in the Off-Topic section if you want an example.)

So yeah, a Sentinels version would presumably do similar, but using Sentinels as its framework rather than the point-based game. And it would be majestic.
